title: Charleston Sailing School & Yacht Charters

services.name: Courses Offered
services.desc: Have you ever dreamed of living aboard or bareboat chartering a yacht? Immerse yourself in the sailing lifestyle. Our Liveaboard Programs provide students with the ability to accomplish multiple certifications while experiencing life aboard a modern cruising yacht. With our Liveaboard programs, we include all certifications, operating expenses, and accommodations during your stay. Charleston provides the ideal setting for our student to relax, learn, and enjoy the sport of sailing. We design our Liveaboard courses to provide a unique and memorable training experience for each student. We keep our class sizes small affording our students more attention, time at the helm, and comfort. Every

blurb: Charleston Sailing School offers unique yachting adventures from our downtown location at Charleston City Marina. Our fleet includes both monohulls and catamarans for Sailing Lessons, Private Yacht Charters, and Bareboat Charters.
